## Description

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Log in as (role: student / partner / teacher / admin) '...'
3. Click on '...'
4. See error

## Expected Behavior

What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior

What actually happened. Include any error messages, stack traces, or
`storage/logs/laravel.log` output if available.

## Screenshots

If applicable, add screenshots or screen recordings to help explain the problem.

## Environment

- OS: [e.g. Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04]
- PHP version: [e.g. 8.2]
- Node version: [e.g. 18.x]
- Database: [e.g. MySQL 8.0 / MariaDB 10.11]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 124]
- Klust version / commit: [e.g. v0.1.0 or commit SHA]

## Additional Context

Add any other context about the problem here (recent changes, custom `.env`
settings, seeded vs. real data, etc.).
